description: This file defines a PHP class 'ReviewEmployeeSupervisorSearchFilterParams' used as a Data Transfer Object (DTO) for filtering review employee supervisor search parameters, including employee number and name or ID, within the OrangeHRM performance module.

classes.name: ReviewEmployeeSupervisorSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A data transfer object class used for filtering search results related to employee reviews by supervisor, allowing filter parameters such as employee number and name or ID.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the object and sets the default sort field to 'employee.empNumber'.

methods.name: getEmpNumber
methods.description: Returns the employee number filter parameter.

methods.name: setEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the employee number filter parameter.

methods.name: getNameOrId
methods.description: Returns the name or ID filter parameter.

methods.name: setNameOrId
methods.description: Sets the name or ID filter parameter.
